Ol Chiki is the writing system for the Santali language
Letter "a" – the first letter of Ol Chiki
Letter "at" – used in words like ᱛᱟᱞᱟ (below)
Practice: Combine ᱚ + ᱛ to form "at"
Vowel "a" – open sound, as in "father"
Vowel "aa" – elongated open sound
Vowel "i" – short "i" sound as in "sit"
Vowel "u" – sound as in "put"
Vowel "e" – short "e" sound as in "bed"
Consonant "ag" – as in ᱜᱟᱰᱟ (river)
Consonant "ang" – nasal sound
Consonant "al" – as in ᱞᱟᱹᱭ (to take)
Consonant "ak" – as in ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤ (work)
Consonant "aj" – as in ᱡᱚᱦᱟᱨ (hello)
Consonant "ach" – as in ᱪᱮᱛᱟᱱ (field)
Consonant "ad" – as in ᱫᱟᱠᱟ (food/rice)
Consonant "ap" – as in ᱯᱟᱱᱛᱮ (path)
Consonant "am" – as in ᱢᱟᱹᱡᱷᱤ (village head)
Vowel "o" – rounded sound as in "go"
Vowel combination "ah" – aspirated
Modified vowel "aa" – checked vowel variant
Modified vowel "e" – nasalized variant
